method: The chart follows one published table of nominal mattress dimensions and does not blend sources: the United States chart from 38.5 × 74.5 in to 72 × 83.5 in, the UK and Ireland chart in the National Bed Federation figures from 76 × 191 cm to 183 × 198 cm, continental Europe from 90 × 200 cm to 200 × 200 cm, Australia from 92 × 188 cm to 204 × 204 cm and Japan from 97 × 195 cm to 194 × 205 cm, 33 sizes in all. US sizes are stored in inches and converted with the exact factor 1 in = 2.54 cm, so a US queen is 152.4 × 201.9 cm; the other four charts are stored in centimetres and shown in inches by the same factor. A named size lists the closest size in each of the other four charts. Both pairs are first ordered short side first, so the shorter side of the mattress is compared with the shorter side of every listed size regardless of which field it was typed into. The gap is the sum of the two side differences in centimetres, rounded to one decimal; the closest size in each chart is the row with the smallest gap, a tie going to the earlier row, and a row counts as close when neither side differs by more than 2 cm. In measurement mode the five closest rows are shown, the single smallest gap is highlighted, and an exact match is reported only when the gap is zero. A width or length is accepted from 40 to 300 cm (15.7 to 118.1 in), which spans a crib mattress to an extra-wide double; the entered number is converted to centimetres before that range is tested, so the same limits apply in both units. Lengths and widths are treated as plain decimal numbers with no thousands separators and no unit suffixes. Results are shown to one decimal place in both centimetres and inches, and the page only compares mattress footprints: it says nothing about frame size, mattress depth, bedding drop or bed height. Published charts disagree by a centimetre or two and retailers round names differently, so the dimensions are nominal and the page says to check the shop's own figures before ordering. Everything runs in the browser with no storage, uploads or network access.
